data.narrative:
Speedata is a Series B-stage semiconductor company that has raised $114M to date. The valuation assessment draws from a comp universe of 5 private peers in the Chips & Semiconductors sector at same or adjacent stages, including SambaNova Systems ($11.0B, Series A), Rebellions ($2.3B, Series A), d-Matrix ($2.0B, Series A), Positron AI ($1.0B, Series B), and DEEPX ($529M, Series C).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using the $114M total raised as a value proxy and applying a typical 1.9x step-up multiplier for Series B to next-stage advancement, implies a valuation of $217M. Peer-median analysis across the 5 same-sector comparables yields a median valuation of $2.0B, with the peer set spanning $529M to $11.0B. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (median 20.5x across ALAB, NVDA, AMD) cannot be applied absent disclosed revenue figures for the target.

The triangulated analysis supports a range of $184M (low) to $2.3B (high), with a median of $1.1B. The wide dispersion reflects fundamental uncertainty around whether Speedata's financial profile and market position track toward the lower end of Series B outcomes or toward unicorn valuations achieved by peer companies. Key uncertainties include revenue scale, customer traction, and the pace of sector consolidation in AI-focused chip design.
